For a working marketing professional with a ₹30,000 ceiling, I’d prioritise SQL + Excel/Sheets + Power BI/Tableau + practical marketing datasets over a heavy Python/data-science bootcamp.

Course	Approx. fit for ₹30k	Weekend/live classes	Practical projects	Marketing fit
upGrad Job-Linked Data Science Bootcamp	₹30,000	Mostly self-paced, so weaker on weekends	10+ projects + capstone	⭐⭐⭐
Great Learning Data Analytics	Usually above budget depending on format	Live online options; schedule varies	Assignments + projects + case studies	⭐⭐⭐⭐
Coursera – Google Data Analytics	Well under ₹30k	❌ Self-paced	Strong hands-on labs/capstone	⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
upGrad GenAI Data Analytics	Usually above ₹30k	Weekend batches available	10–15+ live projects	⭐⭐⭐⭐
My shortlist

1. Coursera – Google Data Analytics — best value

Best if you can learn independently.

Covers spreadsheets, SQL, Tableau/R, data cleaning, analysis and presentation.

Particularly useful for marketing: campaign analysis, customer segmentation, funnel analysis, retention, etc.

Main drawback: no fixed weekend classroom structure.

2. Great Learning — best if you want instructor support

More structured than Coursera, with live online/classroom options, assignments, projects and mock interviews. 
My Great Learning
+1

I'd check the current weekend batch and exact fee before paying because their job-oriented programs can be significantly more expensive than ₹30k.

3. upGrad ₹30k bootcamp — best budget structured-content option

Currently listed at ₹30,000 including taxes.

Includes 500+ hours of content and 10+ hands-on projects including a capstone. 
UpGrad

However, it's primarily self-paced, so it doesn't fully satisfy your weekend-live-class requirement.

4. upGrad GenAI Data Analytics — best curriculum, but over budget

The current Bangalore programme is 4 months and covers Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI and Tableau, with 10–15+ live projects. 
UpGrad
+1

It explicitly offers morning, evening and weekend batches for working professionals. 
UpGrad

But the publicly listed Bangalore fee is around ₹99,999, so I'd only consider it if a scholarship brings it close to your ₹30k budget. 
upGrad Bangalore

What I'd choose for a marketer

If ₹30k is a hard limit:
👉 Google Data Analytics on Coursera + a small Power BI course/project. You'll get much more relevant skill development per rupee than paying for a generic data-science bootcamp.

If weekend live teaching is non-negotiable:
👉 Great Learning first, then check whether they have a ₹30k-or-less weekend cohort. I wouldn't stretch to ₹1L just for a certificate.

The skill stack I'd target:
Excel → SQL → Power BI → marketing analytics → basic Python

You don't need deep ML, algorithms or advanced statistics for most marketing analytics roles.
